description: This file defines the RevolutionLog class, which manages a log of engine revolutions by mapping timestamp to RPM, provides methods to parse revolutions from a string, retrieve crank angles based on time, and handle related calculations.

classes.name: RevolutionLog
classes.description: Represents a log of engine revolutions, allowing parsing from strings, querying angles by time, and managing RPM-time mappings.

methods.name: parseRevolutions
methods.description: Parses a string of revolution data into a RevolutionLog object, splitting input by '!' and mapping time to RPM.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the number of recorded revolution entries.

methods.name: getCrankAngleByTimeString
methods.description: Returns the crank angle as a formatted string for a given time.

methods.name: angle2string
methods.description: Converts a crank angle in double to a formatted string, returning 'n/a' if NaN.

methods.name: getCrankAngleByTime
methods.description: Calculates the crank angle at a specific time.

methods.name: doGetAngle
methods.description: Internal method to compute crank angle with optional fallback to the next revolution.

methods.name: getTimeAndRpm
methods.description: Retrieves the RPM data entry for a given time.

methods.name: keySet
methods.description: Returns the set of timestamps in the revolution log.
